row.name: Manhattan Associates Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)
checks.note: today would be breakout 4 of this move

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=10 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.26 tightness=0.68 base_volume_vs_leg=0.64 base_volume_vs_avg=0.68
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close -0.2% vs its 20-SMA, 7.2% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 2 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The shaded consolidation box sits below a prior peak near 227 that was made in early August, and the burst bar is recovering into that overhead supply rather than breaking to new highs — the base is a rounding rollover from that peak, not a tight shelf at highs. The Y criterion is a hard FAIL: this is the fourth breakout attempt of the same move in 55 sessions, and the chart confirms three visible prior pushes out of the rising channel since late July. The RE criterion also fails — the burst bar is not the widest of the last five bars, which are themselves wide and overlapping inside the box, confirming a loose, spent consolidation.
claude.key_risk: Four breakout attempts in one move means prior buyers who entered on breakouts 2 and 3 are sitting at losses and will sell into any strength, capping the burst.
claude.entry_note: Skip it at the open if price gaps above the 211.54 close without a clean tight first five minutes, or if it opens below 208 and shows no immediate buying — either way the overhead at 220–227 makes the reward-to-risk unacceptable.

row.summary: MANH: +4.8% on 1.3× volume out of a base 11.5% deep. skip 8.5, 5 of 6 criteria.
